changes: Correct outward face orientation for MeshBatch geometry and merged vegetation prototypes in the right-handed Babylon scene.
Derive continuous plaster panels, readable timber bays/braces, plinths and gable kingposts from exact projected cells; keep canonical windows, doors, fitted roofs and reversible cutaways.
Blend terrain with rotated grass/soil samples and macro variation; replace overlapping square path decals with one feathered surface derived from touching canonical path cells.
Add deterministic grove density, sparse settlement greenery and shorter clustered grass with GPU blade-tip wind and reduced-motion support.
Improve roof texel scale, warm material differentiation, leaf highlights, sun arc and moonlight; lower default orbit exploration pitch.
Add reversible projected-weather wetness for exposed materials, including material clones created while raining; preserve dry wall materials.
Add sparse cosmetic planters, log stacks and public-building benches with path/door clearance; no inventory, collision or resource state is created.

orbit.fixture: Movement, interior entry/traversal/exit/reentry and menus use ordinary input. Dialogue co-location, doorway starting position, initial canonical closed-door state and adult combat target staging are disclosed fixtures. No human/controller acceptance.

verification.independentReview: One independent reviewer: no actionable findings. Subsequent source change only restrained grass color/specular constants; final production build and capture include it.
verification.simulationSuite: Not rerun: simulation source unchanged; browser boundary, admission differential, and disposable canonical gameplay checks passed.

performanceLimits: Short warmed Chrome frame-time samples on one Radeon RX 6650 XT, not a cross-device benchmark. Default orbit framing intentionally changed. Other matched views use identical camera positions. Night/rain are presentation overrides, not new canonical history; HUD clock remains the recorded clock.
remainingWeaknesses: Building masses and roof families still repeat; decorative facade shells do not replace the need for stronger architectural archetypes.
Open clearings remain flat and sparsely dressed; field edges and vegetation silhouettes need further art direction.
Characters and many interior props retain their existing simpler geometry/materials.
Night scenes without projected active lights lack warm focal points. Water was not exercised in this scene.
Only WebGL2 was exercised end to end; no claim of validated WebGPU compilation or weak-device performance.
nextImprovements: Expand presentation building families by projected purpose/family, with richer roof-edge and doorway modules.
Improve field margins, canopy silhouettes and low ground cover while preserving canonical clearings and resources.
Refine character materials and animation blending alongside contextual interior prop art.

reproduce.note: Requires the existing local observer recording and private production preview on port 5188. Tests create disposable worlds and accounts, never a retained save.
